title: Parametric reinforcement cage
description: Premium Three.js reinforced-concrete cage study with transparent concrete shell, longitudinal bars, transverse ties, cover and spacing readouts.
learningObjectives: Visualize how clear cover, tie diameter, longitudinal-bar diameter, perimeter bar counts and tie spacing define a three-dimensional reinforcement cage.

rights.attribution: Original LearnMat repository contribution. Runtime uses the declared Three.js 0.185.1 peer; no third-party models, textures, fonts, or datasets are embedded.

verification.notes: 0.2.0 replaces the flat renderer with a host-rendered Three.js scene while preserving the analytical/detailing model. Independent engineering, live-browser, screenshot, and accessibility review remain required before approval.

source.reference: Premium 3D rebuild of reserved structures task str-reinforcement-cage; model logic retained from the original repository contribution.
